style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Repent or Perish
images.concept: The barren tree given one more season — mercy as extension, not exemption from urgency
images.imageAlt: A gnarled fig tree in dry winter soil, the bare branches overarching an empty space, a gardener's digging tool at the base
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a gnarled bare fig tree rising from pale dry winter soil, the branches leafless and spread wide above an empty space of ground, at the base of the trunk a worn iron digging tool or mattock lying in the freshly turned soil, evidence of recent intervention, warm late afternoon light raking from the right catching the trunk texture, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm palette of dry earth and pale bark, the bare tree and the disturbed soil — one more season given, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Freed on the Sabbath
images.concept: Bent double for eighteen years — a body restored to upright on the very day set aside for freedom
images.imageAlt: A shadow on a stone wall that was curved and compressed now becoming upright and full, transition caught in changing light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a rough stone wall with a shadow cast upon it showing a curved compressed form transitioning at one point to a fully upright vertical line, as if the shadow of a bent figure is mid-movement toward standing, the light creating this transition naturally without any figure present, only the shadow on the stone, heavy film grain in the stone texture, muted warm palette of pale stone and soft shadow, the shadow-transition from compressed to upright — freedom visible as shape change, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: Mustard Seed and Yeast
images.concept: Disproportionate growth from invisible beginning — the kingdom working from within and below
images.imageAlt: A single tiny seed on a large stone surface next to a vast tangle of roots from a small tree visible in the foreground
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, overhead macro close-up showing the impossible juxtaposition of one tiny dark seed resting on pale stone in one area of the frame while in another area nearby the gnarled root system of a substantial plant or small tree fans out across the stone, both in the same frame, even soft light across both, the scale difference between the seed and the root system, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm palette, the disproportion between beginning and result, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: The Narrow Door
images.concept: The door standing open — but the time of standing open does not last, and the way is narrower than assumed
images.imageAlt: A very narrow stone doorway in a thick wall, barely wide enough for one person, warm light coming through it from the other side
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a very narrow doorway cut through an ancient thick stone wall, the opening barely wide enough for one person, warm inviting light glowing through from the other side, the door standing open, the thick wall on either side of the opening emphasizing the narrowness of the passage, heavy shadow in the wall stone contrasting with the warm light beyond, heavy film grain in the stone texture, muted warm palette of dark stone and amber light beyond, the narrow opening and the light it frames, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: Lament over Jerusalem
images.concept: How often I wanted to gather you — grief that does not end in despair but in the word 'until'
images.imageAlt: Distant city walls on a hillside seen through heat haze, the light overexposed and bleached, feathers scattered on the ground in foreground
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a distant cityscape or walled settlement on a hillside seen across an empty foreground, the image slightly overexposed through heat haze that bleaches the distant walls toward white, in the immediate foreground a few scattered small feathers on dry pale ground, the distance between the feathers and the unreachable city, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the hazy middle distance, muted near-white palette, the longing across distance — the feathers of the gathering wings and the city that would not come near, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9
